t.1.12.1: Ruru said: How did the kṣatriya Janamejaya harm the serpents? Or why were the serpents harmed, dear father, O best of the twice-born?
t.1.12.2: For what reason were the serpents set free by that Āstīka? Tell me this; relate it to me, for I wish to hear it in its entirety.
t.1.12.3: "You will hear, Ruru, the whole great story of Āstīka from brāhmaṇas as they tell it." Having said this, the seer vanished.
t.1.12.4: The bard said: And Ruru ran about the whole forest on every side, seeking to see that seer; utterly exhausted, he fell to the ground.
t.1.12.5: Having regained consciousness, Ruru went home and told it to his father; and his father, being asked, related to him that whole story.
